title: Observable Feature Extraction
rules: Only CWA_ADMITTED and RRE_ELIGIBLE claims may produce observable features.
Observable features preserve claim meaning and provenance; they do not assign grammar, reality domain, runtime position, or prediction.
One admitted claim may produce one or more features only when the feature is directly stated by that claim.
Missing structure remains UNKNOWN; no missing feature may be inferred merely to complete the dossier.
Feature extraction does not mutate canonical dossier or position registries.
